answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 40835 Country: India Title: In Ramadan, instead of offering tarawih, can we pray the qaza namaz of past year or before that Question: In Ramadan, instead of offering tarawih, can we pray the qaza namaz of past year or before that? Answer ID: 40835 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1303/1303/M=1433) Do not miss tarawih salah as it is sunnah muwakkadah. Keep on offering qaza salah as well along with offering tarawih. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
